cases.estimand: The named association, similarity or distance on common spatial support; multiscale results retain scale before any explicit mean.
conventions: multiscale supports pearson, spearman, fisherz, cosine, l1, jaccard and dcov only
l1 returns 1 minus total variation; dcov calls energy::dcor; jaccard uses proxy eJaccard
exact EMD is a measured intentional divergence target; no exact native solver per owner decision 2026-09-18
cases.independent_case: Nonconstant, constant and zero four-cell vectors expose undefined correlations, zero norms and scale-direction mistakes.
cases.planned_evidence: One pinned and one independent case for every method and failure boundary.
cases.divergence: Seven normalized nonconstant map methods agree with rational oracles and pinned vector/density calls at 1e-12. Native rejects constant correlation, malformed Mass and foreign grids; pinned raw/signed/missing/one-cell results remain recorded. Legacy Fisher clamp is separate. Frozen emd dispatch uses T4transport, not a general exact backend. Analytically exact small plans match pinned outputs and differ from native sliced W1 and squared-cost Sinkhorn; no exact solver or approximation alias.

cases.estimand: A labelled result at every requested bandwidth, optionally reduced by an explicit scale-weighted policy.
cases.independent_case: The 60-digit three-scale oracle detects sigma reuse and silent scale collapse, but intentionally does not claim eyesim KDE parity.
cases.planned_evidence: Pinned eyesim scale-labelled output on a non-symmetric edge case and explicit unequal-scale failures.
cases.divergence: Named matched-scale values and complete means agree. Native sorts unique positive scales, preserves the union and every missing/failed row, exposes requested/contributing counts and refuses incomplete means. R preserves left common-scale order, collapses duplicates, intersects scales and removes missing results when averaging. Native non-square 5x3 Gaussian scales checked against independent 2-D kernel and cosine oracles; continuous-backend KDE divergence stays explicit. Multiscale emd errors at the pin.
